1. (Currently Amended): An immunogenic composition comprising: a modified, live bovine viral diarrhea virus type 1b (BVDV-1b) __that is cytopathic__, a veterinary-acceptable carrier, and optionally an adjuvant.

2. (Currently Amended): The immunogenic composition of claim 1, wherein the modified, live bovine viral diarrhea virus type 1b is __derived from a non-cytopathic BVDV-1b parent strain and has been selected or engineered to exhibit cytopathic properties__.

3. (Currently Amended): The immunogenic composition of claim 1, further comprising __one or more of a parainfluenza virus Type 3 (PI3), a bovine respiratory syncytial virus (BRSV), a bovine herpes virus (BHV-1), a bovine viral diarrhea virus Type 1a (BVDV-1a), a bovine viral diarrhea virus Type 2 (BVDV-2), or an infectious bovine rhinotracheitis (IBR) virus, or any combination thereof; or one or more viral-specific antigens obtained therefrom; provided that the composition does not contain inactivated bacterial antigens from Leptospira__.

4. (Currently Amended): The immunogenic composition of claim 1, further comprising a modified, live IBRV, a modified, live BRSV, a modified, live BHV-1, a modified, live BVDV Type 1a, a modified, live BVDV Type 2, or a modified, live PI3, or a combination thereof; __provided that the composition does not contain inactivated bacterial antigens from Leptospira__.

6. (Currently Amended): The immunogenic composition of claim 1, further comprising an immunologically effective amount of at least a first antigen __that is not an inactivated bacterial culture of Leptospira__.

7. (Currently Amended): The immunogenic composition of claim 6, wherein the at least a first antigen is specific for an organism selected from the group consisting of Actinobacillus, Actinomyces, Bacillus, Bordetella, Brachyspira, Campylobacter, Clostridium, Ehrlichia, Erysipelothrix, Escherichia, Histophilus, Leptospira, Listeria, Mannheimia, Moraxella, Mycobacterium, Mycoplasma, Pasteurella, Salmonella, and Streptococcus, or a combination thereof; __provided that if the antigen is from Leptospira, it is not an inactivated bacterial culture__.

8. (Currently Amended): The immunogenic composition of claim 6, wherein the at least a first antigen is inactivated; __provided that the antigen is not an inactivated bacterial culture of Leptospira__.

12. (Currently Amended): The vaccine of claim 4, further comprising an immunologically-effective amount of at least one microbial pathogen-specific antigen __that is not an inactivated bacterial culture of Leptospira__.
